newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound eases against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound eases against dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound weakened against the dollar on Monday in a private sector market with a plentiful supply of the U.S. currency, bankers said.

"There is a lot of supply on the dollar side," one banker said. Another banker said the market was flush because government treasury bills had matured this week and there was no new offer of bills to soak up liquidity.
Five actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3870 and 3.3920 pounds bid, and at between 3.3900 and 3.3930 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The average rate on Monday was 3.3901 pounds bid and 3.3923 pounds offered in the interbank market, compared to 3.387525 pounds bid and 3.39175 pounds offered on Sunday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.386903 pounds buy and 3.391970 pounds sell.
